### New

- **The model on the drawn display.** In the switch center, each drawn display carries
  its model name on the bottom bezel, like the badge on a real monitor.

### Fixes

- **In-app updates failing on office or shared networks.** The update was downloaded
  through the GitHub API, whose limit of 60 requests an hour is shared by every program on
  the same network; once it ran out, the update failed with "The update download or
  signature verification failed". It now comes from the plain GitHub Releases download
  URL, which has no such limit. This already applies when updating from v0.7.0.
- **A failed update says why.** The message tells a download, a signature check and an
  installation failure apart, and includes the actual cause, such as `403 Forbidden`.
- **Unreadable drop-down lists in the dark appearance on Windows.** The option list was
  light text on a white background, with disabled options nearly invisible; it now follows
  the appearance.
- **A scrollbar in the waiting window on macOS.** The "Waiting for…" and "Switching the
  shared display" window no longer shows a stray scrollbar.
- **The last step of the product tour framed the wrong spot.** It now frames the whole
  Pairing section.

This release uses the same protocol as v0.7.0, so the two pair and switch with each other.

### Known limitations

- A switch from the tray that fails shows no message; it is logged, and reported if
  diagnostics are allowed.
- The macOS DMG uses an ad-hoc signature and is not notarized with an Apple Developer ID,
  so Gatekeeper may ask you to allow it manually.
